components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (for example MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the owner's
            salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied they take precedence. On output this is the composed address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations
            expanded). An owner is valid when it supplies either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1'; when
            present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is the value stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            supplied it is used to derive the owner's age band relative to the
            registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099), fall within
            that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used when creating an owner. When another owner already
            has the same last name and address (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) the create is normally rejected with 409; setting
            this flag to true acknowledges the shared household and allows the create.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the three derived identifiers grouped
        together. Each is rederived under the version-2 algorithm, which mixes a
        fixed 'V2' version tag into the region code used inside the identifiers so
        every value differs from its version-1 form.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            the version-2 region code (the plain region prefixed with the 'V2'
            tag), the 2-digit fiscal year, the first eight upper-case hex
            characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated
            with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the
            digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW27A1B2C3D45'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same
            household (same last name and postcode), rederived under the
            version-2 identity algorithm.
          type: string
          example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate
            detection into a single value: the SHA-256 digest, rendered as 64
            lower-case hex characters, over the version-2 identity input. A create
            is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals
            an existing owner's.
          type: string
          example: '3b8c5b1e2f9a4d6c7e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title and last name
                separated by a single space (for example 'DR who'), or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the
                derived identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) under the
                nested 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registration date. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named
                after the calendar year in which it ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first and last names (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the raw score from which the
                membership level is derived: starting at 0, plus 2 when an email
                address is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3
                when the owner's tenure (the number of fiscal years elapsed since
                the registration date, the fiscal year starting on 1 July) is at
                least 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more. A new owner joining an existing household is capped
                at one above the current maximum membership level among their
                household members; with no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration day at the time it was created, flagging a
                bulk-signup surge.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                at the time it was created, flagging that the city is approaching
                the per-city capacity limit of 50 (at which further creates are
                rejected).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner should be flagged for risk review. True when
                any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate, the email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable
                provider's base name, e.g. a subdomain or a different TLD), or
                the owner's city is over its soft capacity (the capacity warning
                is set); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membership level is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+' and the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by single spaces (for example '+61412345678' is shown as
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the birth date and computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64 inclusive, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate
                detection into a single value: the SHA-256 digest, rendered as 64
                lower-case hex characters, of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '3b8c5b1e2f9a4d6c7e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an existing owner
                by sharing the same last name (by Soundex) and postcode while
                differing in the whole identity key. Such an owner is still created;
                this flag surfaces the likely duplication for follow-up.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner softly matched on last
                name (by Soundex) and postcode with a differing identity key, or
                absent when there is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true while retaining
                the record, and the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - displayName
            - initials
            - pets

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. All 60 checkpoint test classes (70 tests) pass with 0 failures.

### What changed

**1. Version-2 region code inside the identifiers** — `Owner.java`
- Added a fixed `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` and a new `identityRegionCode()` method that returns the plain region prefixed with the tag (e.g. `"V2NSW"`).
- `getIdentityKey()` now mixes `identityRegionCode()` into the SHA-256 input, so the key changes but stays 64 lowercase hex.
- Crucially, `getLocality()`, `getTimezone()` and `getOwnerSegment()` are untouched, so the user-facing `locality` stays the plain region (`"NSW"`) and the segment's area derivation stays plain.

**2. memberId and householdId rederived** — `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `memberIdBase()` uses `identityRegionCode()` as the region prefix (member ids now look like `V2NSW27…`).
- `householdId(owner)` now folds `identityRegionCode()` into its hash input. Because the region derives from the same postcode/city that already defines a household, owners sharing a last name + postcode still resolve to the same household id.

**3. Audit event → schema version 2**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` gained a leading `schemaVersion` field, emitted as `2`; the primary identifier is the v2 memberId.

**4. Response shape** — `openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper.java`
- Added an `OwnerIdentity` schema and grouped `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId` under a nested `identity` object; removed them from the top level.
- Added a top-level integer `apiVersion` of `2`.
- The MapStruct mapper populates `identity.*` from the owner and sets `apiVersion` to 2.

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) were left unchanged, as required.

Every identifier now differs from its version-1 form (no v1 value is reproduced), while `locality`, `timezone` and the owner segment remain the plain region.
